plugin.name: Projects
plugin.description: Projects of a profile, their resources on this computer and actions that switch between them: the Projects screen, the active project in the status bar and on the dashboard.

permissions.projectContext: Reads your profile's projects and switches the active project when you press a project key. Other actions then work on the project you chose.
permissions.resources: Looks up a project's resources on this computer, with the folder or file they are bound to, for the resource actions.
permissions.profile: Reads the active project and the project an action names.
permissions.hostViews: Shows DeckPilot's own Projects screen, the active project in the status bar and its dashboard card.

cycle.name: Cycle projects
cycle.description: Makes the next or previous project of the profile active.

select.name: Select project
select.description: Makes a project of the profile active. Without a project it reports the current one.

current.name: Current project
current.description: Reports the current project of the profile.

repository.name: Project repository
repository.description: Resolves the repository of a project on this computer.

documentation.name: Project documentation
documentation.description: Resolves the documentation of a project on this computer.

resolve-resource.name: Resolve project resource
resolve-resource.description: Resolves a named resource of a project on this computer.

next.name: Next project
next.description: Makes the next project of the profile active.

previous.name: Previous project
previous.description: Makes the previous project of the profile active.

active.name: Get active project
active.description: Reports the active project of the profile.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Next or previous project in the profile's order. Whether the ends wrap around is a setting of the Projects plugin.

projectId.label: Project
projectId.description: Leave on “Current project” to use whichever project is active.

resource.label: Resource
resource.description: The resource name in the project, for example repository or docs.

wrapAround.label: Wrap around
wrapAround.description: Next after the last project selects the first one, and vice versa.

id.name: Project id
id.description: Id of the project in the context

key.name: Project key
key.description: Key of the project in the context

name.name: Project name
name.description: Name of the project in the context

errors.project-not-in-profile: The project does not belong to the active profile.

messages.not-in-profile: the project does not belong to the active profile
